entities.summary: Juan Roca Brunet was a basketball player from Cuba who won the bronze medal with the men's national team at the 1972 Summer Olympics in Munich, West Germany. Roca was also a member of the Cuban team in the 1976 Montréal Olympics, which finished in seventh place.
